title: Overnight transit plan
summary: A practical stay plan for guests arriving at Ternopil bus station and leaving the next morning.
body: This is not a hosted event; it is a guest plan for using the hotel conveniently during a transit stop.
Confirm room availability and arrival time before travel, especially for late arrivals or early departures.

title: Business trip base in Ternopil
summary: A simple stay plan for work travelers who need transport access, Wi-Fi and a practical room.
body: Business guests should confirm Wi-Fi, desk availability by room category, parking options and receipt/payment details before arrival.
The location is practical when transport access matters more than resort-style amenities.
highlights: Work desk in many rooms by public listing notes

title: Family weekend stop
summary: A practical family stay concept using triple and family room categories near central Ternopil.
body: Families can ask about Family room Triple and Family room Triple improved categories.
Confirm exact bed setup, room view, current rate and any child-related needs directly with reception.
